2609.11355.title: SEAR: Segment-Evidence-Aware Routing for Weak-to-Strong Multilingual Speech MCQ
2609.11355.paper_summary: This paper describes our system for Task~2 of the second Multilingual Conversational Speech Language Model (MLC-SLM) Challenge. We adapt Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct with a segment-evidence-aware data and post-training pipeline. A language model converts timestamped ASR into coherent event spans, which are expanded by a boundary margin and cropped from the original recording. We then synthesize complementary semantic MCQs with Qwen3.6-27B and acoustic MCQs with Gemini~3.1 Flash-Lite, followed by structural, grounding, answer-consistency, and target-model trainability checks, yielding 359,825 verified MCQs across 21 language and accent variants. A text-only probe partitions the data into weak, text-answerable items used for supervised fine-tuning and strong, audio-dependent items used for reinforcement learning with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), stabilized by debiased advantages, sequence-level importance correction, and dynamic filtering. Our system obtains 90.92% accuracy on the final official evaluation set.
2609.11355.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文描述了我們在第二屆多語言對話語音語言模型（MLC-SLM）挑戰中任務~2的系統。<lb/>我們使用具有段落證據感知數據和後訓練流程的Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct進行適配。<lb/>一個語言模型將帶有時間戳的自動語音識別（ASR）轉換為連貫的事件範圍，這些範圍通過邊界邊際擴展並從原始錄音中裁剪。<lb/>然後，我們使用Qwen3.6-27B合成互補的語義多選題（MCQs），並使用Gemini~3.1 Flash-Lite合成聲學多選題，隨後進行結構、基礎、答案一致性和目標模型可訓練性檢查，產生359,825個經過驗證的多選題，涵蓋21種語言和口音變體。<lb/>一個僅文本探針將數據劃分為弱的文本可回答項目，用於監督微調，以及強的音頻依賴項目，用於使用群組序列策略優化（GSPO）的強化學習，並通過去偏見優勢、序列級重要性校正和動態過濾進行穩定。<lb/>我們的系統在最終官方評估集上獲得了90.92%的準確率。
